citation_key: Nafisi and Montoya 2019; Nafisi et al. 2021
experimental_scope: Drained triaxial/stress-path response of bio-cemented sands with varying particle sizes and cementation levels.
AE_use: Constrains c-prime/phi-prime increments and stress-path dependence of cemented sand strength.
directness_level: V3 component strength; V4 when used with model hierarchy
usable_variables: stress path, cementation level, particle size, shear response, shear-wave/cementation indicators
limitation: No footing geometry and no long-term environmental degradation sequence.

experimental_scope: 402 unconfined compression tests on MICP-treated sands compiled from the literature.
AE_use: Constrains UCS/CaCO3/treatment-factor priors and checks whether assumed strength increments are within published ranges.
usable_variables: D50, Cu, initial void ratio, CaCl2 concentration, urea concentration, urease activity, optical density, calcite content, UCS
limitation: UCS is not c-prime/phi-prime or footing capacity; environmental modification data are limited.

experimental_scope: 443 UCS test results for MICP-treated sand using geotechnical, biological, and chemical inputs.
AE_use: Independent recent check on dominant UCS drivers, especially calcium carbonate content, treatment cycles, calcium concentration, and urease activity.
usable_variables: mean grain size, Cu, void ratio, urease activity, urea/calcium concentration, treatment cycles, calcium carbonate content, UCS
limitation: No footing response and no direct degradation of shallow foundation capacity.

experimental_scope: MICP-treated sands tested with PLT and UCS after curing; compared with untreated states.
AE_use: Supports initial treated-zone bearing/stiffness plausibility and load-settlement calibration bounds.
usable_variables: ultimate bearing capacity ratio, settlement reduction ratio, UCS, permeability, plate shape/size effects
limitation: Short-term cured tests; no long-term degradation sequence.

source_type: model strip-footing load tests on MICP-treated sand slope
experimental_scope: Strip footing on untreated and MICP-treated 1.5H:1V sand slopes, with 14- and 28-day incubation and 0B/B/2B setback.
AE_use: Supports footing-level bearing-ratio trend and geometry sensitivity.
usable_variables: UBC, BCR, incubation period, footing distance from crest, treated vs untreated response
limitation: Slope geometry differs from level shallow foundation; no long-term degradation sequence.

source_type: soil-column/batch dissolution experiments + reactive transport model
experimental_scope: MICP-treated poorly graded sand columns near 5% CaCO3 subjected to 0, 5, 10, 20, or 50 acidic dissolution injections.
AE_use: Constrains eta(t), residual cementation, and environmental degradation priors.
usable_variables: CaCO3 content, acidic injection count, geochemical/geophysical dissolution observations, calibrated kinetic model
limitation: Chemical permanence/dissolution evidence only; no mechanical footing capacity response.

experimental_scope: Biocemented sand response under wetting-drying, ageing, freeze-thaw/liquefaction-related weathering metrics.
AE_use: Constrains retention factors and supports rejection of permanent-credit assumptions.
usable_variables: UCS/STS/UPV/retention, wetting-drying cycles, ageing period, mass loss/permeability indicators
limitation: Element-scale specimens; not footing-scale bearing-capacity degradation.

experimental_scope: Field MICP/MIDP test plots for slope stabilization and liquefaction-mitigation evaluation.
AE_use: Demonstrates field-scale MICP test-section context for scale and deployment plausibility.
usable_variables: field test-section metadata, slope stabilization/liquefaction mitigation context
limitation: Does not directly calibrate level-footing bearing capacity or long-term degraded capacity.

experimental_scope: MICP-treated desert sand surface specimens measured for 60-day bearing capacity and exposed to acid and freeze-thaw durability cycles.
AE_use: Constrains environmental bearing-capacity retention/loss and supports degradation priors.
usable_variables: bearing capacity, crust thickness, weight loss, bearing-capacity loss after acid exposure, bearing-capacity loss after freeze-thaw
limitation: Surface-crust/biopolymer study; not conventional shallow foundation PLT.

source_type: field MICP bearing-capacity and durability tests
experimental_scope: Taklimakan Desert field MICP trials on dunes and trapezoidal land with surface bearing, erosion, crust, dry-wet cycle, and permeability measurements.
AE_use: Supports field-scale MICP surface bearing-capacity and treated-crust contribution plausibility.
directness_level: V4 field context / V3 bearing component
usable_variables: bearing capacity, erosion depth, crust thickness, dry-wet mass loss, permeability
limitation: Surface stabilization/wind erosion context; no foundation PLT.

experimental_scope: Field tests on artificial mounds and bare sandy land; penetrometer bearing capacity, crust thickness, CaCO3, and wind exposure.
AE_use: Supports field-scale MICP surface strength/crust persistence and durability trend.
directness_level: V4 field context / V3 bearing component
usable_variables: bearing capacity, crust thickness, CaCO3 content, wind exposure, erosion depth
limitation: Surface crust, not shallow footing PLT; weathering duration limited.

experimental_scope: Natural-rainfall field tests on MICP-treated gravelly clay slope with eroded-soil mass and surface-scanning observations.
AE_use: Supports environmental durability limits and nonuniformity/falsification triggers.
usable_variables: accumulated rainfall, eroded soil mass, surface strength, erosion morphology, treatment cycles
limitation: Slope erosion in clayey/gravelly soil; no sand footing capacity.

experimental_scope: MICP-treated soil slopes sampled after 16 months of weathering for CaCO3 loss and drought-mitigation performance.
AE_use: Supports residual cementation loss and rejection of permanent credit.
directness_level: V3 degradation component / V4 field context
usable_variables: CaCO3 content, weathering duration, depth profile, CaCO3 loss ratio
limitation: Drought mitigation/slope context; not footing bearing capacity.

source_type: field EICP biocemented column plate-load analogue
experimental_scope: Field-scale EICP columns in poorly graded sand with plate-load testing, shear-wave velocity, UCS proxy, and carbonate measurements.
AE_use: Analog field-scale carbonate-biocementation support for treated-zone contribution and stiffness/capacity increase.
usable_variables: plate load BCR, stiffness factor, Vs increase, UCS proxy, CaCO3 content, column geometry
limitation: EICP not MICP; column geometry and no degradation sequence.

experimental_scope: MICP-treated sand with palm fiber contents from 0 to 0.30%, measuring bearing capacity, crust thickness, CaCO3, and freeze-thaw retention.
AE_use: Recent external check that bearing capacity and durability vary with CaCO3/cemented matrix structure and environmental cycles.
usable_variables: bearing capacity strength, crust thickness, CaCO3 content, mass loss, bearing-capacity loss after freeze-thaw cycles
limitation: Fiber-assisted surface stabilization; not conventional shallow foundation validation.

experimental_scope: Bio-cemented sand specimens with mode-I and mixed-mode fracture toughness measured as a function of cementation.
AE_use: Provides the best public proxy for fragility/localization and explains why chi_s should be a sensitivity/capping parameter.
usable_variables: fracture toughness, cementation degree, strength, permeability, porosity, low-cementation microcrack-zone behavior
limitation: No footing, no long-term environmental degradation, no direct chi_s calibration.

experimental_scope: Non-destructive characterization of sand-sand calcite bonds, crystallographic orientation, and strain heterogeneity.
AE_use: Supports the boundary that MICP performance depends on local calcite bridge architecture and nonuniform strain localization.
usable_variables: calcite morphology, orientation, intergranular and intragranular strain heterogeneity, localized strain concentrations
limitation: Preprint/micro-scale evidence; not a bearing-capacity or degradation experiment.

source_type: contact-scale calcite-bond tensile strength and tomography
experimental_scope: Bio-cemented grain pairs characterized with synchrotron tomography, SEM, and tensile bond testing.
AE_use: Supports the non-universality of localization and the need to cap credit when active calcite bonding is discontinuous.
usable_variables: tensile bond strength, active calcite fraction, contact surface area, failure mode
limitation: Contact-scale mechanics only; not a direct chi_s calibration for shallow foundations.
